defs.def: a large round object in space that moves around a star (such as the sun) and receives light from it 行星

ex.s: That is a reminder of how little we know of our planet, and that we are not the only creatures with hidden complexities.
ex.t: 这提醒我们对这个星球知之甚少，而且我们不是唯一拥有隐藏复杂性的生物。

ex.s: When "Rise of the Planet of the Apes" was first shown to the public last month, a group of excited animal activists gathered on Hollywood Boulevard.
ex.t: 当《猩球崛起》上月首次向公映时，一群激动的动物保护者聚集在好莱坞大道上。

ex.s: We have looked at our planet from every angle and found all of the wildest things left to find.
ex.t: 我们从各个角度观察了我们的星球，发现了所有尚未被发现的、最奇妙的事物。

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者都必须说明通信或交通技术如何提升了美国人民的历史生活质量。对许多人来说，技术意味着计算机、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的交通工具。然而，技术也是将科学知识应用于解决问题的手段，以无数种方式影响着生活。

ex.s: 6．（1分）The                 that there is life on other planets in the universe has always inspired scientists to explore the outer space．（  ）
ex.t: 6．（1分）宇宙中其他行星上存在生命这一______一直激励着科学家探索外太空。（ ）

ex.s: We have not found life on any other planets yet.
ex.t: 我们尚未在任何其他行星上发现生命。

ex.s: He invented twelve new instruments to study stars and planets.
ex.t: 他发明了十二种新仪器来研究恒星和行星。

ex.s: A mountain on the Moon and a minor planet are named after him.
ex.t: 月球上的一座山和一颗小行星以他的名字命名。

ex.s: Even so, he replies, "I see millions of stars and it's quite likely there are some planets like Earth.
ex.t: 即便如此，他回答道：＂我看到数以百万计的星星，很可能存在一些像地球一样的行星。

ex.s: The benefits are substantial for both gardener and planet.
ex.t: 对园丁和地球来说，益处都是巨大的。

ex.s: After all, exploring the world shouldn’t come ____20____ the planet’s expense.
ex.t: 毕竟，探索世界不应以牺牲地球为代价。

ex.s: Shortly after I received his invitation, applications to join the Youth for Nature and the Youth for Planet groups were sent around through my high school.
ex.t: 收到他的邀请后不久，申请加入自然青年和地球青年团体的表格通过我的高中发放了出来。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关联的新型计时方式这些状况可能因全球变暖而发生变化．我们正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座钟它反映了几条主要阿拉斯加河流的总流量这些河流对当地和全球的环境变化都很敏感．我们已经编程让它在水流保持当前速率时与原子钟同步．如果将来河流平均流速加快钟会比标准时间走得快．如果河流变慢你会看到相反的效果．

ex.s: Transport has a lot to answer for when it comes to harming the planet.
ex.t: 在危害地球方面，交通负有很大责任。

ex.s: There was a bit of me that didn't want to love this when everyone else on the planet did but the horror story is brilliant.
ex.t: 当地球上其他人都喜爱这本书时，我心里有一点不想爱上它，但这本恐怖小说太精彩了。

ex.s: Eyeing these headwinds, plastic-bag makers are hiring scientists like Stein to make the case that their products are not as bad for the planet as most people assume.
ex.t: 面对这些逆风，塑料袋制造商正雇佣像斯坦这样的科学家来证明他们的产品并不像大多数人想象的那样对地球有害。

ex.s: One study found that a cotton bag must be used at least 131 times to be better for the planet than plastic.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋至少要用131次，才比塑料袋对地球更好。

ex.s: Increasing Earth’s reflectiveness can cool the planet.
ex.t: 增加地球的反射率可以使地球降温。

ex.s: But the World Bank has included the project on its of "100 ideas to save the planet＂.
ex.t: 但世界银行已将该项目列入其"拯救地球的100个创意"名单之中。

ex.s: Learning more about the animals with which we share the planet is key to helping protect them.
ex.t: 更多地了解与我们共享这个星球的动物，是帮助保护它们的关键。
